title: Localize the hardcoded English strings in ScopeSelectionScreen and CurriculumSettingsScreen
why: This is a bilingual EN/HE, RTL-supported app (1421 ARB keys) where every other screen in this batch routes text through AppLocalizations, but ScopeSelectionScreen has roughly half its visible copy hardcoded in English: the app-bar title (line 164), the 'All content is included'/'Only selected sections are tracked' subtitle (210-211), the 'Select Scope Level'/'Summary' headers (231, 291), the un-pluralized item-count line (299 -- '1 items will be tracked' is grammatically wrong even in English), and both save-confirmation SnackBar messages (425-426). curriculum_settings_screen.dart also hardcodes its app-bar title prefix (54) and a 'Copy' button label (204). A Hebrew-locale parent configuring curriculum scope -- a core settings flow -- sees a screen that switches between Hebrew and untranslated English mid-sentence.
recommendation: Add ARB keys (EN+HE) for all listed strings, thread through AppLocalizations.of(context)!, and use an ICU-plural key for the item-count line.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity continues to pass with the new keys present in both app_en.arb and app_he.arb.
Widget test with Locale('he') renders both screens and asserts no Latin-script sentence fragments remain in the visible text tree.
